targets.query:
from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1" and r._field == "status")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1" and r._field == "spindle_speed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1" and r._field == "spindle_torque_load")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1" and r._field == "feed_speed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1" and r._field == "part_count")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1" and r._field == "tool_number")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^axis_torque_\d+$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "cnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m80_metrics" and r.machine == "M80_1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^axis_feed_rate_\d+$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
